messages:
sara: @here quick Q — got paged twice overnight by `inference-latency-high`. Where do people usually look for the route-level latency graphs & trace links? also which PagerDuty service is behind that alert? (we should tune filters if it's noisy)

james: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency-per-route — per-route p50/p90/p99. Traces: https://observability.redwood.ai/traces?service=inference
PD service: `redwood-serving` (escalation policy `serving-latency`). PD link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/services/P12345

lee: FWIW the alert is currently `avg(latency_p50, 1m) > 500` which is pretty sensitive for low-qps routes. We had a suppress for <5rps but some routes spike. Recommend: require 2m sustained or add `rate(requests_total[2m]) > 2` to avoid single-request noise.

maria: I can open a PR to change it to `avg_over_time(latency_p50[2m]) > 550` + `rate(requests_total[2m]) > 2`. Will add dashboard link and PD service to the alert metadata and update the runbook.

sara: please also add a playbook bullet: "If paged, check route tags, recent model rollouts, and check model variant QPS." last night it followed a model rollout.

james: Filed an issue to track: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/421 — tagging @maria. Also proposal: escalate to infra-oncall only after 2 pages from the service owner.

maria: taking this — will open PR and update the issue. Targeting EOD for a small alert tweak. cc @sara @lee

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-089 — triggered by inference-latency-high on service redwood-serving

sara: thanks all. If you get noisy pages tonight, please mute the PD service and post here so we can iterate. :thumbsup:
